scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env="" --remote && wrangler deploy --env=""
scripts.deploy:production: SITE_URL=https://laravel.xyz npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote && wrangler deploy --env production
